locations.title: Outpost Quarters
locations.description: Your small, cluttered quarters at Outpost Gamma. There is a door to the corridor to the north.

locations.title: Main Corridor
locations.description: A damaged corridor with flickering lights. A reinforced door leads east to the airlock; a hatch leads deeper south.

locations.title: Airlock Chamber
locations.description: Thick viewport shows the red plains. A low-frequency hum seems to come from the mountains beyond.

locations.title: Engineering Bay
locations.description: Sparks fly from broken consoles. A faint trail of heat leads to the reactor area.

locations.title: Storage Room
locations.description: Crates of supplies. A sealed crate looks promising.
